context: constraint: home-directory resolution must match the watchers fixed in PR #579
intent: Make global steering file creation resolve the home directory from the OS so the write location matches where the extension watches and reads.

No changes to the watcher scoping already fixed in PR #579

decisions.decision: Use os.homedir() with no environment-variable fallback at all
decisions.why: os.homedir() already consults the platform-appropriate source on every OS and always returns an absolute path, so a HOME fallback could only reintroduce the relative-path bug

decisions.decision: Extend the shared vscode mock with withProgress, ProgressLocation, and workspace.openTextDocument
decisions.why: CLAUDE.md requires VS Code API gaps to be filled in tests/__mocks__/vscode.ts rather than stubbed per test file
decisions.rejected: Mocking NotificationUtils inside the new test file

decisions.decision: Mock NotificationUtils in the test file instead of adding withProgress/ProgressLocation to the shared vscode mock
decisions.why: The real withProgress runs its task, so each case awaited a 3s auto-dismiss timer and the file took ~12s; mocking our own notification module keeps the test focused on path resolution and leaves the shared mock unchanged
decisions.rejected: Extending the shared vscode mock with withProgress + ProgressLocation
